title: Mean of a Bernoulli coordinate
statement: Let $p\in\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ satisfy $p\le 1$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $i<k$. Choose a Boolean vector of length $k$ with independent coordinates, each equal to true with probability $p$. The expected value of the indicator that coordinate $i$ is true is $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $k$ coordinates
